description: This file defines the 'Filter' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Core Report Filter namespace. It implements the FilterDefinition interface and provides methods to normalize filter data and retrieve metadata as a ParameterBag object.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class representing a report filter component that can be normalized and can optionally provide metadata.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns an empty array, possibly representing default or uninitialized filter data.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no metadata is available for this filter.
